description: A framework built on React that adds routing, data loading, SSR/SSG, bundling and deployment conventions.
Next.js routing in `app/`: Server Components by default, nested layouts, `loading.tsx` and `error.tsx`.
Next.js 16 directive (with `cacheComponents`) that opts a page, component or function into caching.
Next.js 16 request interception file that replaces `middleware.ts`.
React Router with its Vite plugin: route modules with `loader`/`action`, type safety, SSR, SPA or prerendering. The successor of Remix.
Static HTML pages with isolated interactive components hydrated independently (Astro).
